ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels in the interior lobe regions versus 30% low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels localized along the trailing edge and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large, contiguous high-intensity zones occupy the central and inner-lateral regions of both lobes; low-intensity pigmentation forms a continuous band along the trailing edge (superior boundary) and distal tips; transitional mottling observed at the interface of light and dark zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow, symmetrical V-shaped notch; interior pixel angle estimated at 18 degrees; depth occupies approximately 6% of the visible vertical fluke span.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration characterized by irregular peaks and valleys; pixel-amplitude of variations is most pronounced on the outer thirds of the trailing edge, becoming finer toward the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve following the trailing edge from the distal tips to the median notch; leading edge (inferior boundary) exhibits convex curvature before being occluded by the water line.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized clusters of low-intensity pixel spots (mottling) visible on the lower-interior quadrants of both lobes, appearing as roughly circular disruptions in the high-intensity field.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Faint, near-vertical linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) detected in the mid-section of the right lobe, breaking the high-intensity surface uniformity.
